repro.input: synthetic two-page PDF with a review entity on page 2
actions: click the corresponding entity quote or EntityGroups edit entry in the right pane
repro.expected: select/focus entity and move PageEditor canvas to page 2, or otherwise expose explicit location feedback
repro.actualFromCode: mark quote changes docxFocus and selects original text; EntityGroups onEdit changes mark pagination/index; PageEditor owns local page index and has no external target prop/callback
repro.impact: manual page switching required to inspect mark geometry; risk of location confirmation taking extra steps
repro.classification: possible functional gap; UI contract should be confirmed by root Edge trace

repro.input: synthetic DOCX with two distinct embedded images
actions: select second inline image in layout view
open page/resource review pane and choose image 2
add a region, save and reopen
repro.expected: review box follows image resource and persists on same image
repro.actualFromCode: inline DocxReview image has no direct selection handler; PageEditor exposes independent ordered resource selector; pageReview stores page-index regions; openDoc loads pageReview but PageEditor display index initializes to 0
repro.impact: extra manual step and first resource selected after reopen; persistence needs browser trace

findings.classification: Electron continuous PDF.js/fileURL worker to server-authenticated PDFium page raster/glyph coordinates; no pixel or scroll equivalence claim

actions: change page repeatedly while OCR text is loading
repro.expected: no stale selection or old request mutates another page
repro.actualFromCode: PageEditor resets local selection on doc/revision/index changes and page keyed subcomponents remount; cleanup under actual browser scheduling not observed

repro.input: synthetic PDF with page-render service failure
repro.expected: clear error and no incorrect page image or stale overlay
repro.actualFromCode: local UI requests server PDFium raster and OCR resources; no browser/API fault injection run

limits: No `ledger.json` changes; root owns ledger deduplication and maintain.py checks.
Root should run the two-page sidebar navigation repro before confirming product severity.
